compiled_state.title: MQ-4: merge-to-main-pr.sh MQ promotion path (retire staged-*; session->main direct)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: Behind the MQ config flag: gate/short-circuit _phase_staged_intermediate; _phase_merge opens session->main directly + adds to queue; relocate version bump to session->main pre-push (not staged-*; avoid bug 4668-c3ca); wait-for-pr.sh 'wait until MERGED or evicted' (queue terminal state) so sprint Phase I ancestor check doesn't false-loop; simplify/delete resume/_resume_should_advance_to_staged. Ref: ADR migration step 5; sprint G1/G5/G6/G11.

comments.body: MQ-4 implemented behind dso.merge_queue.enabled (default OFF) per opus-reviewed design, split into 2 increments landed via the still-active two-tier flow: PR-A (wait-for-pr.sh merge-queue terminal-state handling — commit 10b717c9e1, on main via PR #579) and PR-B (flag-gated promotion path in merge-to-main-pr.sh — commit 4cf3b2fe9a, landing via PR #581). PR-B: single early flag read; 3 gated points (merge dispatch flag-ON calls _phase_merge directly session->main; staged-advance block gated to flag-OFF; --resume PR-discovery filter made base==main-aware under MQ); version bump rides _phase_merge pre-push naturally (skip-guard inert on session branch). NO physical deletion of staged machinery / create-sprint-draft-pr retirement — DEFERRED to a post-MQ-6 cleanup story. New test-merge-to-main-mq-path.sh (8/8); flag-OFF byte invariance confirmed via stash-and-rerun. Verified gh exposes mergeStateStatus+autoMergeRequest but no queue-entry field, so terminal detection rests on state+autoMergeRequest+checks (not a non-existent QUEUED enum).
comments.author: Test

comments.body: HOLISTIC-REVIEW FINDING I4 (opus audit, 2026-06-03) — MQ-4 follow-up: wait-for-pr.sh eviction detection is correct (tracks autoMergeRequest non-null->null + mergeStateStatus BLOCKED/DIRTY/BEHIND to name a queue eviction), but the 'queued-behind another sprint' case (ADR friction G5/G8) is governed solely by --timeout (default 3600s). Under parallel-worktree contention, a sprint serialized behind others can exceed 1h of healthy queued-behind wait and hit timeout->exit 1->re-enqueue loop. Follow-up (fold into MQ-6a verification): for the MQ path either raise the default timeout materially OR extend/reset the deadline while autoMergeRequest is present and mergeStateStatus indicates a healthy queue position, so a long-but-progressing queue wait is not false-failed. Verdict on MQ-4 itself: SOUND — flag-gating well-localized (single read, 3 gated points), flag-OFF byte-invariant, version bump correct at max-PRs-per-merge=1 (commits pre-push so the queued candidate is never stale).
